name: Serious Sam Classic for iPhone
subtitle: Sam FE and Sam SE: the classic Serious Sam games on iPhone.
description: Unofficial iPhone builds of Serious Sam: The First Encounter and The Second Encounter, with touch controls. Bring your own game files.

apps.name: Sam FE
apps.subtitle: The First Encounter on iPhone, with touch controls.
apps.localizedDescription:
Serious Sam: The First Encounter, on Croteam's open-source Serious Engine 1. Touch controls made for Serious Sam: a move stick under your left thumb, drag to look, FIRE, JUMP, USE and CROUCH, and a weapon wheel. Tilt aiming, quick save and load, a HUD that fits notched screens, CAMERA (photos, selfies with the enemies posing, Action Freeze, a cinematic burst), network games on Wi-Fi or the internet, and a cheat for relaxed play.

You need your own PC copy of the game: no game files are included. After installing, open the app once, then copy the game's files into Files > On My iPhone > Sam FE. Full guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/SeriousSamClassic/releases/latest

Built on tx00100xt's SeriousSamClassic (https://github.com/tx00100xt/SeriousSamClassic). Unofficial, not affiliated with Croteam or Devolver Digital. Free software under the GNU GPL v2.

versions.localizedDescription: ios-v0.3: CAMERA (photos, selfies, bursts, Action Freeze, cinematic burst), network games, typing in the menus, and the sithewok cheat with a level picker.

privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Turning the device aims, while tilt aiming is on (hold MENU to set it).
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: CAMERA saves your photos and selfies of the game to your photo library.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Multiplayer finds, hosts and joins games on your Wi-Fi.
